webpackMode.description: The mode to use for Webpack.

bundlerMaxMem.description: The maximum amount of memory to allocate to the Webpack bundler.

maxConcurrencyPerNode.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for {@link UiBundler} job per node.
1 means {@link UiBundler} runs webpack compilers sequentially. Set to higher number based on available workers' memory.

waitTimeMins.description: Max time to wait for bundling to finish.

makePkgUpdatable.description:
Ui bundling requires updatable pkg. If pkg is readonly, setting to true will copy readonly pkg to writeable store
and make it updatable.
